hypothesis: Profitable firms with persistently low news coverage may be underappreciated; comparing profitability and slow-moving coverage directly may produce a steadier signal than multiplying their ranks.
mutation_reason: The held underfollowed_profitable_firms factor has positive five-day IC (0.0185) but a low IC t-stat (0.493), while standalone ROE also has positive but weak IC. Replace the four-operator product with a three-operator rank spread and use 60-day news coverage to test persistence.
expected_metric_effect: Higher five-day IC significance and more consistent positive folds than underfollowed_profitable_firms, without worsening turnover or after-cost Sharpe.
falsification_condition: Reject if five-day IC significance does not improve, positive-fold consistency deteriorates, or after-cost Sharpe worsens versus underfollowed_profitable_firms.
